This site brings together mathematics notes, theses, exercises and other documents from the [math-notes repository](https://github.com/GrothenSerre/math-notes).

The [mathematics section](../../mathematics/index.qmd) groups material by topic. The [document archive](../../documents/index.qmd) provides direct access to all downloadable files.

Longer writing will appear under [Essays](../../essays/index.qmd); this blog is a place for shorter notes and updates.
